title: Stage 9 — Production Environment Validation & Release Certification
summary: Release certification. Baseline integrity, environment contract, clean-checkout reproducibility, full API smoke test (42 checks), and security regression (14 checks) all PASS. Live AI, live object storage, live production DB, and browser E2E remain BLOCKED — ENVIRONMENT (no credentials/infrastructure present), not FAIL. One new metadata change: pinned packageManager to pnpm@10.34.5 (pnpm 11 silently mutates pnpm-workspace.yaml and breaks --frozen-lockfile). No application defects remain.
